We’re drag racing a Ferrari Purosangue, Lamborghini Urus Performante and Porsche Cayenne Turbo Electric over the 1/4-mile and 1/2-mile. We’ll also compare the three in a 100mph brake test.

Explore new and used car deals with Carwow: https://bit.ly/Change-Your-Car-24-07

It’s time for a head-to-head between the three fastest European SUVs! 

We’ve got our hands on the all-new Porsche Cayenne Turbo Electric, and it’s going up against the Lamborghini Urus Performante and the Ferrari Purosangue! 

The question is, can either of the ICE cars spring a surprise on the EV? Let’s check out the stats…

The Ferrari is powered by a 6.5-litre naturally-aspirated V12 that pumps out 725hp and 716Nm. Power is sent to all four wheels via an 8-speed auto gearbox, and it weighs in at 2,033kg. It’s easily the most expensive car here, with the starting price coming in at £313,000.
